title: Critical Review Dispatch Envelope
description: The exact Task payload one verified receipt authorizes, written once after every bound byte has been re-read and the council re-resolved. `tasks` is the transmission itself, not a description of one: each item carries the reviewer's whole assignment with the verified scope and packet bytes reproduced inline, so nothing a reviewer reads depends on a path still holding what it held at freeze. The envelope cannot carry its own digest or the dispatch marker built from it, which is why `dispatch` prints that marker instead of storing it.

schemaVersion.description: Pins this envelope contract; a consumer that accepts an unknown version is guessing at what would be transmitted.

panelId.description: The live panel definition the receipt resolved under, so an envelope built under a superseded panel is visible rather than silent.

leadFamily.description: The accountable main-session model family whose profile granted every assignment its standing.

reviewClass.description: Which resolution this envelope transmits: one configured critic outside a council, the complete selected council, or the complete fixed refutation pool.

subjectDigest.description: The frozen subject's whole-identity digest, joining this transmission to the same subject the receipt and every reviewer assignment bind.

receiptPath.description: Absolute path of the resolver receipt this envelope was built from. The verifier re-reads it and repeats the whole resolution rather than believing this envelope's summary of it.

receiptSha256.description: Digest of the exact receipt bytes, so a receipt edited between resolution and transmission is detectable rather than assumed unchanged.

taskIntent.description: The generated intent line of the authorized Task call. Fixed rather than caller-supplied: the verifier approves an exact payload, so an intent chosen at the call site would leave one field of the compared object outside the comparison.

tasks.description: One canonical Task item per resolved reviewer, in resolver order. The dispatcher transmits this array exactly and never adds, removes, reorders, retypes, or supplements a member.

tasksSha256.description: Digest over the canonical form of `tasks` alone, so a ledger row can cite the transmitted evidence by one stable value that survives any reformatting of the envelope around it.

agent.description: The native Task agent for this reviewer, resolved from the qualification authority. The `review-` prefix is what makes the item protected, so the policy extension can recognize a reviewer dispatch without knowing any reviewer's name.

task.description: The reviewer's complete assignment, beginning with the resolver-receipt marker and its machine header. It carries the resolved standing and the verified scope and packet bytes; a reviewer never infers, chooses, or renegotiates its own standing, and never depends on a path to still hold the reviewed material.
Exactly two keys. Every optional Task field is omitted so that nothing in the compared payload has a default that could drift between the verifier and the call site.
